prompt:
The damage has grown worse, still in the same clean chunky toy style. Exactly these: one big jagged bite missing from the top of the battlements along the front wall, a clean sharp-edged gap in one royal blue turret roof, one corner turret broken down to the top of the wall, one dormer and a patch of the wing roof caved in as a simple angled break, the chimney snapped to a stump, and one row of large blocky rubble pieces along the foot of the walls. The keep still stands at its full height otherwise. Everything else exactly as it is.

Same building, exactly the same camera angle, framing and plain light grey background, same art style and colours. Damage is big simple shapes with clean sharp edges. No fine gravel, no scattered small stones, no cracks, no dirt. No fire, no smoke, no people. Royal blue stays only on the parts that still stand. The building must look strictly worse than before: nothing repaired, nothing cleaner.
